tools.name: convert_tool_schema
tools.description: Convert one LLM tool/function definition between OpenAI, OpenAI strict mode, Anthropic, Gemini, MCP and plain JSON Schema. The input format is auto-detected. Every change is reported as an issue with a JSON pointer. Free: 5 calls/hour per IP with arguments up to 8 KB; then $0.01 USDC per call via x4

tools.name: lint_tool_schema
tools.description: Check one LLM tool definition against each provider's schema rules (OpenAI strict, Anthropic, Gemini, MCP) and report errors and warnings with fixes. Free: 5 calls/hour per IP with arguments up to 8 KB; then $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openapi_to_tools
tools.description: Turn an OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 spec (JSON object) into LLM tool definitions in the chosen format, one tool per operation. Free: 5 calls/hour per IP with arguments up to 8 KB; then $0.02 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: batch_convert_tool_schemas
tools.description: Convert up to 50 tool definitions at once to the chosen formats, with per-tool issues and ready-to-use bundles. Free: 5 calls/hour per IP with arguments up to 8 KB; then $0.05 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: mcp_manifest
tools.description: Generate an MCP server manifest (tools with inputSchema, titles, annotations, HTTP bindings) and a TypeScript stdio server stub from an OpenAPI spec or a list of tools. Free: 5 calls/hour per IP with arguments up to 8 KB; then $0.15 USDC per call via x402.
